events.title: 선덜랜드 play their last game at Roker Park after 99 years and go out on a high by beating 에버턴 3–0, but are still in danger of Premier League relegation. Their local rivals 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain in contention for the league title with a 1–0 win at 아스널 – a result which rules the North Londoners out of the title race. 리버풀 remain in it with a 2–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. Paul Kitson ensures 웨스트햄 유나이티드's survival with a hat-trick in their 5–1 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이, whose UEFA Cup hopes are ended by the result. 코번트리 시티, meanwhile, are left needing a miracle to save their 30-year tenure in the top flight due to a 2–1 home defeat by 더비 카운티.
스토크 시티 beat 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 2–1 in their last game at the Victoria Ground , their home for a national record of 119 years.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드's goalless draw at 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 리버풀's 2–1 defeat at 윔블던 means that 맨체스터 유나이티드 are Premier League champions for the fourth time in five seasons. In 리버풀's defeat, 마이클 오언 scores the consolation goal in only his second appearance for the club, making him the club's youngest ever league goalscorer at the age of 17 years and 144 days.
A late Matt Elliott goal for 레스터 시티 three points from 셰필드 웬즈데이, making the East Midlands club safe from relegation.

On a dramatic final day of the Premier League season, 코번트리 시티 pull off a miracle survival act by beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at White Hart Lane . 미들즈브러 – who would have survived at the expense of Coventry had it not been for their points deduction – go down after being held to a 1–1 draw by 리즈 유나이티드 at Elland Road. 선덜랜드 lose 1–0 to 윔블던 at Selhurst Park , but their fans are left waiting after the final whistle to hear whether their team have survived; when the news comes through that Coventry have won, it is confirmed that 선덜랜드 are relegated.
애스턴 빌라 pay a club record £7 million for 리버풀 striker Stan Collymore .
에버턴 sign Croatian defender Slaven Bilić from 웨스트햄 유나이티드 for £4.5million.
첼시 end their 26-year wait for a major trophy, and 뤼트 휠릿 becomes the first foreign manager to win one, with a 2–0 win over 미들즈브러 in the FA Cup final.
첼시 wins the FA Cup by defeating 미들즈브러 2–0.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are left shocked after their iconic striker 에리크 캉토나 announces his retirement from football six days before his 31st birthday. Cantona, who won four league titles and two FA Cups in five seasons at the club, explained that he had always intended to retire while still at the top.
에리크 캉토나 , the famous and controversial French footballer in the Premiership , announces his retirement from football.
